# CG-API-002: Operation added

The candidate adds a new operation.

**Why it matters:** Additions widen what the provider accepts.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Operations and paths](./#api) |
| Detects | `operation.added` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Operation {operation} was added.
>
> New operations do not affect existing consumers.
>
> **Fix:** No action needed.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: new operation

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /a: {get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /orders: {post: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. Operation POST /orders was added.

### Does not fire: operation present in both

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /a: {get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-API-002
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-API-002: { severity: low }
```
